title: Insulated overalls model 104/1 OC
text:
Dostępne rozmiary: 48, 50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62

Insulated overalls model 104/1 OC
SKU: 104/1-00019-48/XS
104/1 OC
Aquapros - aquaproof
Breathable waterproof clothing

Professional overalls designed for work, especially in low temperatures and high ambient humidity. Made of the highest quality aQuaAir waterproof material with vapor-permeable features, additionally insulated from the inside with polyester wadding, ensuring comfort of use in difficult conditions, regardless of the type of activity performed. The suit will work well in various industries and services, and will also be appreciated by hobbyists (fishing, water sports).

Main material: Polyester / PU with a weight of 190 g/m2 +/- 5%

Insulation: Polyester 120 g/m2 +/- 5%
